title: investigation link/1
description: The payload an investigation link carries (#i1 or #i2, then the deflated or raw base64url JSON): exactly one of a pack (`p`, a gravitas.investigation-pack, at the lowest version that carries it: i2 only for a pack with a criterion kind, depth or weight), a delta (`d`, the change to a pack held in the page) or the key of a package installed in this browser (`k`, which opens nothing on another machine and says so). js/composer/packLink.js readPackFragment() returns each of the three and refuses anything else as `notPack`, and a wrong kind, a newer prefix or a corrupt fragment by reason code. FORMATS.md lists it.
